verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is managed sandbox infrastructure for AI agents. Infrastructure products can plausibly offer built-in AI insights, for example over metrics or logs, so the axis applies. The evidence documents runtime metrics, historical logs, and an audit ledger, but no first-party AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. Hosting a user's own agent is a building block, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
